Update all my UI to use less of the primary color and more gray colors:

- My sidebar buttons shoudl use text foreground and muted background. When not selected just have text muted foreground without the background
- When there is a update on the agent (i.e. it is done) then no matter if selected or not, we display the text of the chat fat and using text foreground
- the cards should also have a slighlty lower py padding
- The repaly button should use secondary bacgrkudn
- The pebbles in our status tooltip (which should be a popover actually) should be white (when completed) or gray (when still pending)
